Now I write on topics I enjoy and that is the best part I like about my job.   Know More © X/Indian Football Team It was not the ideal welcome for the  Blue Tigers when they landed in  Bangladesh  for the SAFF Championship. In fact, it was a nightmare as far as the Indian football team was concerned. They arrived in Dhaka on November 3 at 2.15 pm. From there, the players were taken to a private hotel on Gulshan Avenue. That was when everything went wrong. 
 Table of Contents
 Nightmare Welcome in Bangladesh 
 Poor Logistics by Bangladesh 
 Why Are Key Players Missing? 
 Which Teams Are Playing? 
 Nightmare Welcome in Bangladesh 
 When they arrived, the players were informed that the rooms were not allocated. This was unexpected. As per a Sportstar report, as late as 5 pm rooms were still not allotted. Nobody saw this coming. 
 © X/Indian Football Team 
 “There have been other arrangements that are being made. We hope this will be sorted soon,” a source revealed, as per the report.
 Poor Logistics by Bangladesh
 Eventually, things were sorted out. The Indian football team did finally get its rooms after a logistical error. Not something one would expect when everything was planned beforehand. Or should have been at the very least. 
 © X/Indian Football Team 
 Why Are Key Players Missing?
 India have won the SAFF Championship nine teams and have sent a second-string squad. The main players are touring New Zealand for two friendlies. U -23 head coach Naushad Moosa was left without more key players because clubs refused to release them.
 Which Teams Are Playing?
 The Blue Tigers open their campaign vs Pakistan in Group B.  Maldives  are also in that group. Group A consists of Sri Lanka, Bangladesh and Bhutan. The top two teams from each group enter the semis and the final is on November 17. 
 Frequently Asked Questions
 How many times has the SAFF Championship been won by India? India have won the SAFF Championship nine times.
 Who are in India's group in the SAFF Championship? India are in Group B in the SAFF Championship along with Pakistan and Maldives.
 When is the SAFF Championship final? The SAFF Championship final is on November 17.
 Which teams are in Group A of the SAFF Championship? Group A of the SAFF Championship features Bangladesh, Bhutan and Sri Lanka.
 Why is it a second-string sent by India? India have a second-string team as key players are touring New Zealand for two friendlies and many players were not released by their clubs. Somak Adhikari Consultant Specialty: Sports
